body:
The first production #461 report completed without deleting anything and
correctly held all 24 candidates on unclassified dependencies. All 64 reported
errors are four `shared-mime-info-2.4/tests/mime-detection/disk.*` samples in
16 source trees. They are small MIME-detection test fixtures, not QA guests.
The report also correctly identified two real QCOW backing dependencies.

Classify the source samples only after exact comparison with the pinned
shared-mime-info archive: full archive digest, exact member and target digest,
file identity, and protected source location. Do not skip source directories
or general extensions. Unknown or altered files still prevent a proposal.
Use directory-entry metadata to retain complete traversal coverage without
repeated filesystem metadata calls; the first scan took about 14 minutes.

Can this be done on the VM? No: these are host storage/source-archive facts.
Use isolated host controls and a fresh read-only production report.

- [x] The report records each exact archive-verified source fixture while
  preserving all real disk, backing-chain and cross-store checks.
- [x] Controls reject a changed fixture, changed archive, unprotected fixture
  or unclassified disk; the existing active/use/preservation controls pass.
- [x] A fresh full-root report records actual eligible/held candidates and
  H700 capacity, with original refusals and all source/evidence hashes retained.

Already written: no player data or production storage was changed. Report01
remains an intact held-removal result. No deletion is authorized by this fix.


## Completed read-only reporting

Published on next `510196b072f3bec9c108ef2ad4709e30aaa40bde`. The fresh report inspects 3,722,420 directories and the same 311 disk chains as the original report. All 24 original QA disk hashes/identities and protected-root identities are unchanged. Sixty-four exact source samples match the pinned shared-mime-info archive; nineteen controls pass. There are zero unresolved dependencies, 22 eligible files and two held referenced bases. The original conservative refusal remains retained.

[Report and source provenance](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/510196b072f3bec9c108ef2ad4709e30aaa40bde/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-pixelelated-replacement-16/retention-review-02); [independent reconciliation and exact proposal](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/510196b072f3bec9c108ef2ad4709e30aaa40bde/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-pixelelated-replacement-16/h700-retirement-proposal). No deletion occurred. The earlier D-INFRA-019 batch remains the completed first later batch. New execution is separately tracked in #491 and awaits its own explicit authorization; the report does not extend the earlier approval.
